verdict.rationale: No evidence item names an official SDK. The adjacent support is a published OpenAPI spec (from which clients could be generated) and Observability-as-Code docs about defining dashboards and data sources in code for CI/CD, which implies programmatic building but never confirms first-party SDK libraries. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK libraries, documented languages and package distribution, SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against an SDK.
